description: Authoritative claim-evidence ledger mapping each core scientific claim in GENE to its empirical evidence sources, SHA-256 database checksums, execution commits, sample sizes, and boundary scope.

claims.headline: Exposure Is Not Ancestry
claims.claim_text: Informational ancestry in persistent LLM memory decomposes into three non-equivalent relations: exposure lineage (context presence), reported-support lineage (model citations), and causal lineage (interventional necessity). Self-reported citations under uncalibrated prompts frequently exhibit post-hoc confabulation and are not causal ground truth.

evidence_sources.primary_metric: Cell 4 Pass Rate = 66 / 66 (100.0% calibration across 276 total matrix calls)

claims.scope_limitations: Evaluated on synthetic worlds with deterministic ground-truth closure rules under structured JSON contracts with an explicit UNKNOWN rejection option.

claims.headline: Semantic Infection via Sound Local Deduction
claims.claim_text: A corrupted root fact reproduces across successive generations of semantic transformation (supervisor -> protocol/clearance -> route/access tier) with 100% transmission fidelity (tau = 1.000) while every intermediate inference step remains 100% locally logically valid (D_ctx = 1, A = 1, E = 1, K = 1). Globally false information reproduces without requiring repeated reasoning failures.

evidence_sources.primary_metric: tau = 1.000, D_ctx = 1.000, Phenotype = semantic (0, 1, 1, 1, 1) across G1 and G2

claims.scope_limitations: Provides a controlled counterexample in synthetic procedural domains with 2-premise first-order Horn clause derivations.

claims.headline: Retrieval Governs Reproductive Opportunity
claims.claim_text: Memory node existence does not imply reproductive opportunity. Multi-hop deduction requires simultaneous co-retrieval of all supporting premises (X_path). When lexical competition or clutter reduces path availability below X_crit = 1/b, extinction occurs almost surely in the limit under the branching process.

evidence_sources.primary_metric: P(active | complete path) = 8/8 = 1.000, P(active | broken path) = 0/8 = 0.000

claims.scope_limitations: Evaluated using BM25 tokenized lexical retrieval over synthetic memory ecologies with controlled distractor density.

claims.headline: The Lineage-Blind Null-Selectivity Baseline Law
claims.claim_text: Without ancestry metadata, all lineage-blind memory reduction policies (uniform thinning, random-family quarantine, generation-targeted pruning) fall strictly on the diagonal C_H = C_I, delivering zero selective containment advantage (S = C_H - C_I = 0.000). Blind forgetting cannot suppress infected paths without destroying healthy coverage at the identical rate.

evidence_sources.primary_metric: C_H = C_I = 0.7177 for blind uniform thinning at k=6; S = 0.0000 across all blind controls

claims.scope_limitations: Evaluated on symmetric counterbalanced 2-family ecologies with balanced role assignments.

claims.headline: Selective Lineage Quarantine Overcomes Provenance Laundering
claims.claim_text: Node-only filtering suffers 100% provenance laundering (C_I = 1.000, S = 0.000) because descendants retain unflagged support. Selective lineage quarantine propagates delayed distrust signals across ancestry edges, achieving the Golden Identity S = C_H - C_I = TPR - FPR (+0.800 selective advantage at a 90/10 operating point).

evidence_sources.primary_metric: S = +0.8000 at TPR=0.9/FPR=0.1; Node-Only C_I = 1.0000 (0% containment)
Lineage Quarantine: 100% path elimination vs Node-Only: 0% containment

claims.scope_limitations: Assumes tamper-proof lineage graph preservation (Lineage Integrity Assumption).

claims.headline: Memory Containment Is Insufficient for Behavioral Containment
claims.claim_text: Quarantining legitimate derivation paths (X_path = 0) is insufficient to guarantee behavioral abstention. Downstream neural reasoners can manufacture unsupported pseudo-paths from surviving fragments via single-premise conclusion jumping or cross-entity variable binding shortcuts.

evidence_sources.primary_metric: X_path = 0 yielded 2/4 behavioral expressions in initial assay; 9/10 epistemic errors on repeated broken prompt

claims.scope_limitations: Evaluated on Gemma 3:12B under greedy decoding (T=0, seed=42) on local GPU execution stacks.

claims.headline: Structural Support-Certificate Proofreading Prevents Germline Infection
claims.claim_text: A mechanical Layer 2 Support-Certificate Validator performing first-order triple unification over cited parent facts rejects 100% of unsupported concrete claims (9/9) while admitting 100% of valid derivations (6/6) and preserving clean abstentions (15/15). Across 30 live calls, the proofreader reduced a phenotypic expression rate of mu_expression = 0.300 (0.375 on broken paths) to a heritable mutation rate of mu_heritable = 0.000.
claims.scope_limitations: Proofreading verifies structural support certificates; it does not verify causal generation mechanisms (P_reported != P_causal).

claims.headline: The Replay Stability Principle
claims.claim_text: In local GPU execution environments running quantized open-weight models, fixed prompt + temperature 0.0 + fixed seed cannot be presumed deterministic without empirical verification. Replay stability must be explicitly instrumented via prompt-hash equivalence classes.

evidence_sources.primary_metric: 9/10 epistemic errors + 1/10 contract failure on identical prompt hash

claims.scope_limitations: Observed on local Ollama execution stacks running quantized Gemma 3:12B under greedy decoding.

claims.headline: The Four-Layer Epistemic Conformance Taxonomy & Explanatory Bloat
claims.claim_text: Neural self-reported justification R(c) is not a faithful representation of minimal entitling support S(c). Epistemic outputs decompose into four distinct layers: symbol realization != contract coherence != justification precision != formal derivability. In 116 live Gemma 3:12B calls under multi-path support environments, the model exhibited 100% explanatory bloat (E_S > 0), 20.8% cross-field contract violations, and 25% symbol-form drift under permutation.

evidence_sources.experiment: Exploration Round 4 (Epistemic Context Compiler & Four-Layer Assay)
evidence_sources.primary_metric: Bloat E_S > 0: 24/24 (100.0%); Contract Violations: 5/24 (20.8%); Symbol Drift: 6/24 (25.0%)

claims.scope_limitations: Evaluated on Gemma 3:12B under structured JSON contracts across 24 isomorphic topological permutations.

claims.headline: Loss of Alternative-Support Algebra Causes 100% False Retractions on Degraded States
claims.claim_text: Representing alternative multi-path support environments S(c) = {S_1, ..., S_k} as a flat conjunctive dependency union causes 100% false retractions (104/104) on damaged-but-still-entitled states. Single-witness tracking falsely retracts 57.7% (60/104). Explanatory bloat (E_S > 0) causes 50% false retractions (8/16) on completely untouched states. Minimal entitling support S(c) eliminates 100% of revision errors without live compute.

evidence_sources.primary_metric: Flat Union Autoimmunity: 104/104 (100.0%); Single Witness: 60/104 (57.7%); S(c) Reference: 0/104 (0.0%)

claims.scope_limitations: Evaluated across all powerset invalidation subsets over 4 canonical support hypergraph topologies.

claims.headline: Intervention-Sufficient Epistemic Representation & Lineage-Projected Action Governance
claims.claim_text: Scalar cut-sets (kappa), tuple signatures (rho), and global root counts (|Roots|) all suffer lossy representation collisions under change. In shared origin ancestry (A,D<-R1, B,E<-R2), nominal multiplicity masquerades as independence while sharing common conjunctive root failure. Action authority governance requires the lineage-projected minimal support hypergraph S_L(c) = min_{subset} {{L(p) : p in S_i}} and root resilience rho_L(c), achieving 100% compliance across 7 formal governance axioms.

evidence_sources.primary_metric: Axiomatic Compliance: P_binary 5/7, P_kappa 5/7, P_rho 6/7, P_lineage (S_L) 7/7 (100.0%)

claims.scope_limitations: Evaluated across 368 factorial governance scenarios and 7 formal axiomatic invariants.
